title: Make partial post-model OpenCode timeout test independent of the 30 ms notification race
outcome: Make partial post-model OpenCode timeout test independent of the 30 ms notification race
acceptance: The opencode_post_model_timeout_preserves_and_applies_reported_dependent regression deterministically observes the partial effort notification before exercising the missing-mode timeout, using an owned phase or controlled clock.
Keep the existing exact model, effort, mode, write-count and single-notice assertions; do not increase the production timeout, retry the test or weaken the timeout behavior.
